**Finding submitted: deviation (high severity).**

Section 2.2 makes Copperleaf "Customer's sole and exclusive provider of hosted analytics services throughout the term" — full-term exclusive dealing with no category limit, no time limit, and no performance-based exit. That is our walk-away position, and it also contradicts Section 12.3, where Vendor acknowledges Customer has made no exclusivity commitment.

**Redline (validated, ok:true):** delete paragraph 2.2 in full, with the fallback (hosted analytics only, 12 months, auto-terminating on SLA/delivery failure) offered in the comment if exclusivity is commercially essential.

I confirmed no other exclusivity obligation binds Meridian — the remaining "exclusive" references concern remedies (19.4, 21.4, 30.2) and jurisdiction (28.2). Note separately that Section 2.1's take-or-pay minimum-volume commitment sits adjacent to this clause and is likely a deviation under the minimum-volume/commitment rule, but it falls outside this rule's scope.
